description: Free commission calculator: sales or real estate commission at a flat or tiered rate, your take-home after a split and fees, and sales needed for a goal.

jsonld.name: Commission Calculator
jsonld.description: Commission calculator for flat or marginal tiered rates with brokerage split, per-deal fees and sales volume needed for an income goal.

acceptedAnswer.text: Split arrangements vary widely by brokerage, industry and experience — 70/30 is a commonly cited example, but actual splits range broadly and are often negotiable, especially as your production increases.

mainEntity.name: Does this calculator handle tiered commission structures?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose "Tiered" and set up to three bands. Each rate applies only to the portion of the sale inside its band, the way marginal tax brackets work.

mainEntity.name: How do I calculate commission on a sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: Multiply the sale amount by the commission rate — for example, $50,000 × 5% = $2,500. Then multiply by your split percentage and subtract any per-deal fees to get your take-home.
